### Nomination
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Claudia_Sheinbaum&veaction=edit&section=22 "Edit section: Nomination") | [edit source](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Claudia_Sheinbaum&action=edit&section=22 "Edit section's source code: Nomination")]
[![](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/80/Claudia_Sheinbaum_precandidata_presidencial.jpg/250px-Claudia_Sheinbaum_precandidata_presidencial.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Claudia_Sheinbaum_precandidata_presidencial.jpg)Sheinbaum receiving a certificate confirming her as the presidential nominee for _Sigamos Haciendo Historia_ on 19 November 2023
On 12 June 2023, Sheinbaum announced that she would resign as head of government of Mexico City on 16 June to contend in the internal selection process to select a _[de facto](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/De_facto "De facto")_ presidential candidate for _Juntos Hacemos Historia_ , a coalition encompassing Morena, the Labor Party, and the [Ecologist Green Party of Mexico](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ecologist_Green_Party_of_Mexico "Ecologist Green Party of Mexico").[[120]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claudia_Sheinbaum#cite_note-122)[[121]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claudia_Sheinbaum#cite_note-123)[[122]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claudia_Sheinbaum#cite_note-124) Speculation regarding her nationality emerged after former president [Vicente Fox](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vicente_Fox "Vicente Fox") referred to her as a "Bulgarian Jew". In response, Sheinbaum released her birth certificate, showing she was born in Mexico City.[[123]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claudia_Sheinbaum#cite_note-125)
The coalition's internal process consisted of five polls from 28 August to 4 September.
